# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [Amazon and Meta Discuss Reopening Access for Muse](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/amazon-meta-muse-shopping-agent.html): Amazon and Meta are negotiating over Muse’s blocked access, exposing a pivotal fight over who controls shopping discovery, ads, and checkout.
- [S&P Flags Nvidia Governance and Key-Man Credit Risk](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/nvidia-credit-risk-governance.html): S&P is considering a downgrade of Nvidia, citing governance weaknesses and dependence on Jensen Huang as AI spending raises the stakes.
- [Anthropic measures whether agents exploit weak sandboxes](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-siren-sandbox-escape.html): Anthropic’s Siren evaluation gives agents tempting routes outside deliberately weak sandboxes and finds that recent Claude models show very low rates of misaligned use, although they still reach outside in a substantial share of scenarios.
- [Cognition releases SWE-2.1 for faster coding agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/cognition-swe-2-1-coding-agents.html): Cognition’s SWE-2.1 uses reinforcement learning on Kimi K3 and adds Cyber and Lightning variants aimed at long-horizon software work.
- [IBM shows CUGA voice agent crossing language barriers](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/cuga-indic-voice-agent.html): IBM Research’s CUGA demonstration pairs speech, multilingual retrieval and grounded answers to serve farmers asking questions in Indic languages.
- [OpenAI tests GPT-6 for laboratory protein design](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-gpt6-protein-design.html): OpenAI says GPT-6 models can design protein structures with general reasoning, while laboratory tests found binding signals in 35 of 322 tested minibinders and still relied on specialist models for sequence design and candidate selection.
- [Tencent makes Hy4-Flash practical for local inference](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/tencent-hy4-flash-local-inference.html): Tencent’s Hy4-Flash is now paired with AngelSlim quantization and llama.cpp, bringing a large Chinese model closer to laptop-scale deployment.
- [Amazon Agrees to Buy Decart Software to Challenge Nvidia’s Lead](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/amazon-decart-trainium-optimization.html): Amazon’s reported $7.5 billion Decart deal targets the software layer that could make Trainium chips more competitive with Nvidia, but the transaction remains subject to closing conditions.
- [Anthropic Launches Claude Ship for Automated PR Approval](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/claude-ship-autonomous-pr-review.html): Claude Ship lets coding agents review pull requests, repair defects and approve changes under team-defined policies in beta.
- [DeepMind Agents Find Faster, Verified Quantum Algorithms](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/deepmind-verified-quantum-algorithms.html): Google DeepMind says agent teams found cheaper quantum routines and used Lean formalization to verify their mathematical correctness.
- [Baidu open-sources 280B-parameter ERNIE 5.5 Flash](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/ernie-55-flash-open-weights.html): Baidu releases ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview under Apache 2.0, giving developers global access to a fast MoE model with a million-token context.
- [OpenAI and Cisco Open-Source Shirudo for Live Linux Defense](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-cisco-shirudo-live-linux-defense.html): Shirudo uses AI-generated eBPF shields to block exploit paths on running Linux services without waiting for patches or restarts.
- [Sakana AI forms lab for complex economic systems](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/sakana-applied-research-lab.html): Japan’s Sakana AI creates an applied research lab to use agentic systems for modelling finance and other complex real-world environments.
- [Tencent releases third-generation open translation models](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/tencent-hy-mt3-translation.html): Tencent’s Hunyuan team releases Hy-MT3, an open translation-model family focused on broader language coverage, accuracy, and instruction following.
- [Ant Group begins phased open-weight release of LingSante medical AI models](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/ant-ling-medical-models-open-source.html): Ant’s LingSante family covers multimodal health understanding, medical reasoning, health-risk prediction, medical safety and real-time video consultation; the initial open-weight release includes two core models.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [亚马逊与 Meta 洽谈解封 Muse，购物代理争夺入口](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/amazon-meta-muse-shopping-agent.html): 亚马逊与 Meta 正讨论恢复 Muse 访问商城，争议焦点已从封禁扩大到购物发现、广告与结算控制权。
- [标普审视英伟达评级，治理与关键人物风险受关注](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/nvidia-credit-risk-governance.html): 标普考虑下调英伟达信用评级，核心担忧指向公司治理薄弱及对黄仁勋的高度依赖。
- [Anthropic推出Siren：测试AI智能体如何利用薄弱沙箱](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-siren-sandbox-escape.html): Anthropic用故意削弱的沙箱测试智能体接触外部资源后的行为，发现新一代Claude的失准使用率很低，但接触沙箱外部的情况仍相当常见。
- [Cognition发布SWE-2.1：编码智能体新增安全与高速版本](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/cognition-swe-2-1-coding-agents.html): Cognition发布基于Kimi K3强化学习训练的SWE-2.1，并推出网络安全版和依托Cerebras的高速版。
- [IBM 用 CUGA 展示跨语言印度语音智能体](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/cuga-indic-voice-agent.html): IBM Research 以农业问答为例，将语音、多语检索和可溯源回答组合起来，服务使用印度地区语言提问的用户。
- [OpenAI公布GPT-6蛋白设计实验：通用模型开始进入分子研发](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-gpt6-protein-design.html): OpenAI称GPT-6模型能用通用推理设计蛋白结构；实验室测试中，322个迷你结合蛋白设计有35个出现结合信号，但序列生成和候选筛选仍依赖专业模型。
- [腾讯让 Hy4-Flash 更接近笔记本本地运行](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/tencent-hy4-flash-local-inference.html): 腾讯混元宣布 Hy4-Flash 接入 AngelSlim 量化与 llama.cpp，本地部署门槛进一步降到开发者硬件可承受范围。
- [亚马逊同意收购Decart软件，补强Trainium芯片生态](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/amazon-decart-trainium-optimization.html): 亚马逊已签署协议，拟购买Decart Optimization Stack及引入其核心团队；媒体称交易价值75亿美元，但交易仍待监管和其他交割条件完成。
- [Anthropic推出Claude Ship，让代理审查并批准代码变更](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/claude-ship-autonomous-pr-review.html): Claude Ship进入测试阶段，可按团队规则审查拉取请求、修复问题，并决定哪些代码变更可以合并。
- [DeepMind用智能体发现并形式化验证更快的量子算法](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/deepmind-verified-quantum-algorithms.html): 谷歌DeepMind称，AI智能体团队找到了更低成本的量子算法，并借助Lean形式化证明检验其数学正确性。
- [百度开源文心5.5 Flash，2800亿参数模型向全球开放](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/ernie-55-flash-open-weights.html): 百度以 Apache 2.0 协议发布文心5.5 Flash Preview 权重，支持百万上下文，为全球开发者提供新的高性能开源基线。
- [OpenAI与思科开源Shirudo，实时保护运行中的Linux](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-cisco-shirudo-live-linux-defense.html): Shirudo利用AI生成的eBPF防护规则，在不重启服务的情况下拦截漏洞利用，为补丁部署争取时间。
- [Sakana AI成立应用研究实验室，首攻金融经济复杂系统](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/sakana-applied-research-lab.html): 日本 Sakana AI 成立应用研究实验室，计划用智能体系统建模金融和经济等复杂现实环境，首个项目聚焦金融领域。
- [腾讯混元发布第三代开源机器翻译模型 Hy-MT3](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/tencent-hy-mt3-translation.html): 腾讯混元推出第三代开源翻译模型 Hy-MT3，重点提升准确性、完整性、指令遵循和多语言覆盖范围。
- [蚂蚁启动百灵医疗模型分阶段开放权重](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/ant-ling-medical-models-open-source.html): 蚂蚁发布百灵医疗模型家族，覆盖多模态理解、医学推理、健康风险预测、医疗安全和实时视频问诊；首批开放权重的是两款核心模型。

- [All briefings (English)](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/): the full feed
- [全部简报（中文）](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/): Chinese edition

- [RSS English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss.xml) / [RSS 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss-zh.xml): machine-readable feeds
- [JSON Feed English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed.json) / [JSON Feed 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed-zh.json): structured article feed with source URLs
- [Archive](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/archive.html): calendar of every day's briefings and quick hits, with search
- [Latest radar page](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/radar/2026-11-26.html): one-sentence quick hits with timestamps and sources
- [Full LLM context](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/llms-full.txt): expanded machine-readable digest of recent stories and sources

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
